name: table
description: Semantic data table with headers, body, footer, and accessible caption
designIntent: Table displays tabular data with proper semantics. TableHead uses scope=col, TableCaption provides an accessible summary, and rows support hover/selected states.

props.name: children
props.description: TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, and TableCaption children

examples.title: Basic table
examples.description: Table with caption, headers, and data rows

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Table for layout
antiPatterns.explanation: Tables are for tabular data. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox for page layout.

antiPatterns.title: Don't omit the caption
antiPatterns.explanation: Screen readers use the caption to describe the table's purpose.

accessibility.implementation: Native table/thead/tbody/tfoot with scope attributes on headers
accessibility.userRequirements: Use scope=col on column headers, scope=row on row headers

guidelines: Include the time period or unit

compositionRules.relationship: Place column headers in a TableHeader with TableRow
